description.value: Lynn's Vietnamese is a Vietnamese restaurant located in Vernon, BC. It represents one of the dining options catering to those craving Southeast Asian cuisine in the Okanagan region. Touring cyclists passing through Vernon may find it a welcome stop for a hot meal after a long day on the road.
